title: Purulia Zilla School
text: Secondary (89.7%) and Higher Secondary in science (85%). Took apart everything that had a screw in it.

title: Joined NISER, Integrated M.Sc. Physics
text: Physics major, chemistry minor, supported by the DAE DISHA studentship (2018–2023). Joined the Robotech Club in my first year.

title: NIUS Fellowship & radio astronomy
text: Two-week NIUS programme at HBCSE-TIFR Mumbai, with workshops at NCRA Pune and the Giant Metrewave Radio Telescope. This is where astronomy stuck.

title: Chandrayaan-2 landing outreach
text: Co-organized the campus event for the Chandrayaan-2 landing, built a lunar rover prototype and a Tesla coil for Open Day.

title: Hack-duino & autonomous quadcopter
text: Co-organized the national-level Hack-duino 2021 hackathon and led the club's ArduPilot autonomous quadcopter.

title: Master's thesis: lunar thermal correction
text: Built a thermal-correction pipeline for Chandrayaan-1 hyperspectral data with iterative Hapke modelling. Presented at IPSC-2023, Ahmedabad.

title: Chandrayaan-3 Data Analysis Workshop
text: Selected for ISRO's data workshop. Back at NISER, co-organized the Chandrayaan-3 landing live stream.

title: Project intern: photometry & a printed spectrometer
text: Extended the thermal method to Chandrayaan-1 and 2 photometry, and designed a 3D-printable VIS–NIR spectrometer.

title: Guest scientist at MPS Göttingen
place: Max Planck Institute for Solar System Research, Germany
text: Invited to present at the Ceres Workshop, supported by the MPG Ceres Fellowship (2024–2025).

title: Ceres spectrophotometry with Dawn VIR
text: Hapke modelling, phase curves and artifact correction across five Dawn mission phases. Presented at NSSS-2024 (Goa), IPSC-2025 and STEP-2025 (Roorkee).

title: Underwater pipeline rover
text: Hardware for a 100 m depth inspection rover, and a low-cost BP monitor built from hacked consumer devices.

title: ISRO fellowship: Chandrayaan-2 IIRS pipeline & goniometer
text: Junior Research Fellow on the ISRO/DoS-funded Chandrayaan-2 Science Project. Currently looking for a PhD position in planetary science and instrumentation.
